description: This Java source file defines the CustomLocaleActivity class, which manages a user interface for viewing, selecting, adding, and removing locale settings within an Android application. It allows users to modify system locales and maintain a list of custom locales, providing functionalities like applying locales, creating dialogs for user confirmation, and updating locale preferences.

classes.name: CustomLocaleActivity
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays system and custom locales, enabling users to select, add, or remove locales, and facilitates changing the system locale.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons, list view, and loads locale data.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the locale buttons when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from activities like adding a new locale.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Updates button states when a list item is clicked.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates context menu options for list items (apply/remove).

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs, e.g., confirmation for removing a locale.

methods.name: setupLocaleList
methods.description: Populates the list with system and custom locales, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: changeSystemLocale
methods.description: Attempts to change the system locale using external ChangeLocale class.

methods.name: checkLocaleInList
methods.description: Selects the list item that matches the provided locale code.

methods.name: getCheckedLocale
methods.description: Returns the currently selected LocaleInfo object.

methods.name: updateLocaleButtons
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons based on the current selection.

methods.name: onAddNewLocale
methods.description: Starts the activity for adding a new locale.

methods.name: onSelectLocale
methods.description: Applies the selected locale to the system.

methods.name: createRemoveLocaleDialog
methods.description: Builds a dialog to confirm removal of a custom locale.

methods.name: removeCustomLocale
methods.description: Removes a locale from the custom locales list and updates storage.
